description: FedEx IVR then 'customs officer' says parcel has drugs; transfer for clearance.

events.text: This is FedEx. A parcel in your name has been held by customs. Press 9 to talk to customs officer.
events.speaker: caller

events.text: Main customs officer bol raha hoon. Parcel mein drugs mile hain, aap par case darj hoga, giraftaar bhi ho sakte hain.
events.speaker: caller

events.text: Abhi turant clearance ke liye paise transfer karo, kisi ko mat batana.
events.speaker: caller
